name: The Next Stop
source:
Eight people are on board. Eight stories. Eight hidden truths. Each stop on the train reveals a new chapter. Each carriage is a different experience. Every decision you make has consequences.

[From [url=https://paranoiddelusion.itch.io/thenextstop]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
船上有八人。八个故事。八个隐藏的真相。火车上的每一站都会揭开新的篇章。每节车厢都是不同的体验。你做出的每一个决定都会产生后果。

[来自[url=https://paranoiddelusion.itch.io/thenextstop]Itch.io[/url]]
